note: Review finding on quince#66, found by running the architect leg on an architect box. The gate correctly detected the architect role and then printed the implementer's `--repo` form — and the hint exists precisely to be copied verbatim, so requiring the reader to correct it defeats the reason it is spelled out. An architect that copied it would arm a watch SMALLER than its declared set, leaving a repository unwatched: the failure `.claude/forge-set` was built to prevent (quince-devlog#3). It would also then SATISFY this gate, which is a check passed by obeying its own remedy. Two architect repositories are listed here on purpose: `--all` covers the declaration whatever its size, so they must collapse to one line, while the implementer gets one line per repository it opened a PR in.
